faqTopics.label: Secure Ordering
faqTopics.lede: How a request moves from submission to release, and how patient data is handled along the way.

questions.q: How long does it take to process a request?

blocks.text: 1. Standard provider requests

items: Verification is automatic once an active license is on file — instant for accounts in good standing.
Clinical review of the patient-specific prescription usually takes 1–2 business days.
Compounding and release checks add a further 1–3 business days depending on the preparation.

blocks.text: 2. Made-to-order preparations

items: Combination formulations and preparations requiring extra quality checks are released more slowly.
These typically take 5–10 days before they are ready to ship.

blocks.text: 3. Out-of-state requests

items: Shipments crossing state lines follow the receiving board’s requirements before release.
Total time to delivery can run 7–21 days depending on the state and the carrier service selected.

blocks.text: In summary

items: Standard requests: 2–5 days
Made-to-order preparations: 5–10 days
Out-of-state requests: 7–21 days or longer

questions.q: Is prescription and patient data transmitted securely?

blocks.text: Every request is submitted over an encrypted connection and stored against your practice record. Patient identifiers are visible only to the prescriber on file and the dispensing pharmacist.

questions.q: Who is allowed to submit a request?

blocks.text: Only verified, licensed providers. Patients cannot order directly and should contact their prescribing provider, who submits the patient-specific prescription on their behalf.

faqTopics.label: Track Order
faqTopics.lede: Where to find the status of a request, and what to do when tracking goes quiet.

questions.q: How can I check the status of an order?

blocks.text: 1. Check your email

items: A confirmation email is sent as soon as the request is received.
A second email follows with the tracking number once the order ships.
Use the tracking link in that email to check status without signing in.

blocks.text: 2. Sign in to the portal

items: Open “My Orders” in your practice dashboard.
Each line shows its current stage — In review, Compounding, Shipped, Delivered — with the estimated release date.

blocks.text: 3. Use the tracking number

items: Once shipped, track the parcel on the carrier’s site (FedEx, UPS).
Cold-chain parcels carry a separate temperature-controlled service level and show their own scans.

blocks.text: 4. Contact provider support

items: If the portal and email do not answer it, contact support with your order number and account email.

questions.q: What should I do if tracking hasn’t updated?

blocks.text: Carrier scans can take 24–48 hours to appear, especially over weekends. If nothing changes for more than 3 days, contact provider support and we will trace the parcel.
Temperature-sensitive preparations ship in validated packaging and are released only on days that allow delivery inside the qualified window.

faqTopics.label: Orders & Shipping
faqTopics.lede: Timelines, coverage, and what can still be changed after a request is submitted.

questions.q: How long does shipping usually take?

blocks.text: Standard shipping is 3–7 business days; express arrives within 1–3 business days. Times vary by state and by the carrier service required for cold-chain parcels.

questions.q: Can I modify or cancel an order after submitting it?

blocks.text: 1. Before the request is processed

items: While a request is still in review, most details can be changed or the request withdrawn.
Do this within a few hours of submitting.
Changes usually available: shipping address, payment method, adding or removing line items.

blocks.text: 2. After compounding has started

items: Once the preparation is in production or packed, changes are no longer possible.
A cancellation can still be requested, but it is handled as a return once delivered.

blocks.text: 3. Patient-specific preparations

items: Made-to-order sterile preparations cannot be modified or cancelled once compounding begins.

blocks.text: 4. How to cancel or modify

items: Check your confirmation email for the request link.
Open the request in the portal to see whether Modify or Withdraw is still offered.
Contact provider support with the order number for anything the portal will not let you change.

questions.q: Do you ship to every state?

blocks.text: We ship wherever the pharmacy holds an active non-resident license. Eligible states and available service levels are shown at submission.

faqTopics.label: Payment & Account Credit
faqTopics.lede: Accepted methods, practice-level invoicing, and how account credit is issued and spent.

blocks.text: 1. What account credit is

items: A prepaid balance held against your practice account and applied to future requests.
It is usually issued after an approved return or a corrected invoice.
It is not cash and can only be used on this portal.

blocks.text: 2. How to use it

items: Select “Account credit” at submission.
The request total is deducted from the available balance.
If the request exceeds the balance, pay the remainder by card or ACH.

blocks.text: 3. How it is issued

items: Approved returns: credit is issued in place of a refund to the original method.
Corrected invoices: pricing or quantity adjustments are returned as credit.
Cancelled requests: credit is issued when the original charge has already settled.

questions.q: What payment methods do you accept?

blocks.text: Major credit cards, ACH transfer, and practice-level invoicing on approved accounts. All payments are encrypted.

questions.q: Can the practice be invoiced instead of paying per order?

blocks.text: Yes — verified practices can request net terms. Contact provider support to have invoicing enabled against your account.

faqTopics.label: Returns & Refunds
faqTopics.lede: What can be returned, how to report a problem, and when a refund lands.

questions.q: What is your returns and refunds policy?

blocks.text: Sterile compounded preparations cannot be returned to stock once they have left the pharmacy. Preparations that arrive damaged, incorrect, or outside their temperature window are replaced or refunded in full.
Report an issue within 7 days of delivery with the order number and lot. Once approved, refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to the original payment method or as account credit.

questions.q: What if a vial arrives damaged or incorrect?

blocks.text: Keep the packaging, photograph the parcel and the label, then open a report from the order in the portal. Replacements ship on the next qualified shipping day.
5–7 business days after the return is approved. Card refunds can take one additional statement cycle to appear.

faqTopics.label: Account Info
faqTopics.lede: Verification requirements, account details, and adding prescribers or staff.

questions.q: Do I need an account to submit a request?

blocks.text: Yes. Ordering requires a verified provider account — there is no guest submission. Verification confirms your license, practice address, and shipping states.
An active state license number, DEA registration where applicable, the practice address, and a licensed contact for formulation questions.

questions.q: How do I update my account details?

blocks.text: Update contact details, password, and saved shipping addresses from your account dashboard. License and practice changes are re-verified before they take effect.

questions.q: How do I add prescribers or staff to a practice account?

blocks.text: Invite them from Account → Team. Staff can build requests; only verified prescribers can sign and submit them.
